This situation raises concerns regarding the effectiveness of current safety measures aimed at misrepresentation in visual content.

 - Commercial image generation models can create misleading visuals that appear credible.
 - The EpiReal-Bench benchmark highlights risks associated with visual misinformation generated by such models.
 - Over 70% of false claim prompts result in images that realistically depict misinformation.

Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.11112

Türkiye ranked fifth in terms of total exports but had the most diverse customer base, selling drones to 28 countries.

 - The U.S. and Iran dominate military drone exports, contributing to ongoing conflicts.
